findings.title: Players lose all remaining mission markers when checking the map mid-mission — the new marker loop is guarded by `!MX.cur`
findings.observed: Opening the map during a mission hides every unfinished daily mission dot.

findings.title: Players can still lose The Pitch during a phone call or tab switch — visibility correction runs only on return while hidden frames continue advancing and judging beats
findings.observed: Hidden-tab frames can still mark Pitch beats missed and fail the mission before return.

findings.title: Players on a slow connection can hear the cloned voice over the stand-in and skip office dialogue — the clip timeout starts fallback without cancelling the pending audio or its end handler
findings.observed: A clip delayed over 1.5 s can play over its fallback and advance the sequence twice.

findings.title: Players lose the new office-visit count and repeat the wrong opener after reloading — the checkpoint is saved before entry and `dirExit` never saves the increment
findings.observed: Reload immediately after leaving: the save still has the previous dirUses count.

findings.title: Portrait phone players can still lose part of the mission timer after setting a personal best — the widened centered timer sits behind the higher-z-index vitals panel
findings.observed: At 360px portrait, a timer with a PB tag extends behind the left vitals panel.

findings.title: Phone players cannot read all daily mission names on the fitted map — fixed-size labels are drawn at nearby markers without collision handling
findings.observed: At 360×640, the Day 1 Chai Run and Yulu Time Trial labels overlap on the fitted map.

findings.title: Players keep hearing the stand-in after a brief network outage — three failed clip starts permanently disable all cloned lines until reload
findings.observed: After three initial clip failures, `noClips` stays true for the rest of the page session.

findings.title: Players can be left waiting indefinitely for office choices after an audio stream fails mid-line — the error handler treats an already-started clip as settled
findings.observed: A clip error after `onplaying` is ignored and no fallback advances the dialogue.

findings.title: The team cannot regenerate the advertised voice clone in a clean deployment — the script depends on an undeclared ffmpeg package and an unserved reference recording
findings.observed: `clone` uses `/tmpref/ref.mp3`, but no such route/file or ffmpeg dependency is supplied.

findings.title: Players who pause or take a call miss the rest of Adhiraj’s cloned line — the pause handler stops playback and resume advances the subtitle without restarting audio
findings.observed: Pausing during an office line cancels it; resuming only types the rest silently.

findings.title: Yulu players see conflicting leaderboard positions on the same result card — the new rank uses three rivals while the result chip uses a separate eight-rival board
findings.observed: A Yulu result can show different `#… on the board` ranks in its text and chip.

findings.title: Yulu players can see the wrong position for a repeated tied time — rank lookup matches name and rounded time instead of the newly inserted run
findings.observed: Two runs by the same player at 60.12s both resolve to the first matching position.

findings.title: Phone players may miss the zero-star office subtitle — the brushoff is embedded in a non-wrapping, ellipsized toast instead of a readable dialogue line
findings.observed: On a narrow phone, the long one-line brushoff toast is ellipsized.

findings.title: Players overwrite their prior checkpoint just by asking Adhiraj a question with no wanted stars — the generic building interaction saves before checking the office’s zero-star branch
findings.observed: A zero-star office interaction calls `saveGame('enter', …)` before the brushoff.

findings.title: Players who revisit the office immediately after clearing their stars cannot hear the zero-star brushoff — the cooldown rejects the interaction before checking wanted level
findings.observed: Returning immediately after a visit shows `Adhiraj is in a meeting` instead of the brushoff.
